title: API key used from a new IP address
description: Events attributed to an API key came from a source IP never seen for that key before. The first IP per key is learned silently.

mitre.name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Application Access Token

false_positives: Integrations running on serverless platforms with changing egress IPs (Make, n8n cloud).
tuning: NEXORA records API key activity mainly on failures; this rule sees only those events. Disable for keys used from dynamic IP pools.
